ab03_fix.what: Body-weight force columns (grf_*_BW) divided by 113.5 kg x 9.80665 for all 40 AB03 recordings; the local table's 82.18 kg is never read. Every other participant uses its README mass (equals the participant file).
ab03_fix.which_forces_depend_on_mass: Only the _BW columns. C06 force columns in N are checked equal to the plate columns in all 488 recordings (no mass inside); pressure point (m), heading and angles hold no mass; moments and powers are per kg and handled by the rescale, not by the body-weight mass.
ab03_fix.pilot_check: AB03 poses_1 loaded total vertical force: median 1.0036 BW with 113.5 kg (113.9 kg implied; C02 audit said 113.8 from plates). The old 82.18 kg would give 1.39 BW.
ab03_fix.other_ab03_check: Recordings with loaded stance show 0.92 to 1.08 BW median in dynamic tasks, as expected (not standing).

units_note: Recorded in every ledger row and Parquet metadata: README says N*m and W, data are per kg, labelled Nm_kg and W_kg, not divided again.

checks.unit_tests: tests/test_gt23_m01.py 9 passed (synthetic known factors 78.9/71.5 = 1.1035, 84.1/113.5 = 0.741; only listed class rescaled; inconsistent audit stops; kept array is the same object; body weights at known mass; power consistency invariant; N*m check recovers mass; committed audit gives 488/52/436/7/45/2/434)
checks.per_recording: every rescaled recording: scaled/source equals the factor to 2e-16 on every column and the finite pattern is unchanged; every kept recording: moments and powers equal the source exactly
checks.force_n: all 488: C06 N columns equal X01 plate columns exactly
checks.power_consistency_note: Power = moment x (sign x C06 speed), sign +1 hip, -1 knee, +1 ankle (published knee coordinate is the negative of flexion). Slope and correlation are identical before and after rescale (largest difference 1.6e-15 in slope, 1.4e-15 in r) because moment and power carry the same factor. The agreement itself is limited by our recomputed speeds: rescaled recordings median slope 0.96 (0.54 to 1.24), median r 0.974 (0.73 to 0.998); kept recordings median slope 0.99, median r 0.981 (min 0.29, 2519 leg-joints). Right-leg values are empty where the right plate is missing.
checks.inverse_dynamics_nm: Local inverse_dynamics.sto exists for 8 exact-tier recordings that cover normal walking; rescaled moment x own mass vs N*m: AB06 1.1e-5, AB08 3e-13, AB12 8e-6 N*m (pass 1e-3); AB05 0.068, AB10 0.078, AB09 1.29 N*m (fail 1e-3; 0.02%, 0.03%, 0.5% of peak; least-squares implied masses agree with the mass used to 5 significant digits for AB05/AB10 and to 0.1% for AB09); AB13 not checked (the .sto has 50002 rows, the recording 52903); AB01 (own mass 78.9, kept) 0.10 N*m. Acceptance wording asked for 1e-3 N*m; this is not met for 3 of the 7 and not checkable for 1. The factors are unchanged: they come from table masses, not from this check, and nothing was refit.
